_help: 10-word motion vocabulary for the gallery. Each piece's primary motion is classified into one node. mutate.py uses the adjacency graph to evolve descendants into neighboring motion cells (a lightweight MAP-Elites flavor — fill the grid with diverse, high-quality motions before re-densifying any one cell). User feedback (2026-05-07): pieces like td1 over-rely on rotation; this graph forces the search to explore. Generated as direct response to: 'first generate 10 motion words, then use [MAP-Elites] or other method to construct motion graph and evolve on that.'

drift.kinetic: slow, directionless, gentle currents — particles wander as if in still water or low-altitude air
drift.physics: low-velocity Brownian-ish with weak directional bias; no sharp transitions

pulse.kinetic: rhythmic expansion-contraction around a center — heartbeat / breathing / lighthouse rotation as luminance
pulse.physics: scalar(t) = a + b·sin(ωt) modulates radius / scale / brightness; strict periodicity, never noise

cascade.kinetic: gravity-led flow, top-to-bottom or one-directional collapse — particles obey a force vector
cascade.physics: constant acceleration along one axis; some elements settle, others overflow downstream

spiral.kinetic: rotational + radial — particles trace a logarithmic or Archimedean spiral inward or outward
spiral.physics: θ̇ = const while r increases or decreases monotonically; coherent angular momentum

murmur.kinetic: collective swirl with internal eddies — flock-like emergence, individuals influence neighbors
murmur.physics: boids-style separation+alignment+cohesion; visible substructures forming and dissolving

ascend.kinetic: defying gravity — particles rise with reverence; bouyant, slow, deliberate
ascend.physics: negative-y velocity capped, jitter low, occasional pause — anti-cascade

shatter.kinetic: explosive divergence from a center — instantaneous outward velocity, then settling
shatter.physics: impulse at t=0 from origin, decay over ~1-3s; trails optional but should fade

trace.kinetic: single-direction line-laying that leaves a persistent mark — drawing in time
trace.physics: head moves at steady velocity; trail accumulates; the path is the work

breathe.kinetic: slow scale modulation of the entire form — the whole piece expands and contracts
breathe.physics: global transform.scale = 1 + 0.05·sin(ωt) where ω corresponds to ~3-7 sec/cycle

propagate.kinetic: wave/signal transmission across space — ripples spread; neighbors fire after a delay
propagate.physics: wave equation or cellular automaton; visible wavefront moving outward at finite speed

_design_note: 10-word vocabulary — small enough to reason about, big enough to span the motion-behavior space. Adjacency = which transitions read as 'natural evolution' vs jarring jump. The mutation worker can: (a) HOLD the parent's motion (small mutation), (b) STEP to an adjacent word (medium), (c) JUMP to a non-adjacent word (large). Variety bias preferentially fills under-represented words. Coverage of all 10 words by lineage = behavioral diversity, the implicit MAP-Elites elite-set goal.
